name: Ninoy Aquino International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the main one, 06/24, is 3,737 m long and 60 m wide; 13/31 is 2,258 m long and 45 m wide
runway.quote: Runway 06/24. NAIA's primary runway is 3,737 meters long and 60 meters wide ... Runway 13/31. Its secondary runway is 2,258 meters long and 45 meters wide

ppr.v: non-scheduled flights (commercial and non-commercial) need MIAA approval of a flight advisory, filed at least 3 days ahead (2016 rule)
ppr.quote: Application must be filed in advance with a minimum notice period of three (3) days

handling.v: non-scheduled flights must use an MIAA-accredited ground handler or FBO (no names listed)
handling.quote: All Air Carriers or Operators of non-scheduled flights must secure the services of MIAA accredited Groundhandler/FBO

missing: notable (GA peak-hour limits reported in news could not be confirmed from an official source)
notes: Philippine AIP needs a registered account (ais.caap.gov.ph), so no AD 2 data. NAIA has been run by a concessionaire since the O&M start date; the 2016 MIAA rules on flight advisories and FBOs may have been replaced by the concessionaire's rules - check before publishing. News reports of private-jet limits at NAIA are not used.
